VALID/STALE/CONFLICT is a projection-integrity witness, not a quality score or priority signal.
residue: If ordinary use shows the five source-witness rows add more reading burden than re-entry clarity, Test H requires contraction/deletion rather than expansion.
Stopping machine writeback belongs at the ops-hub generator/transport boundary, not in FIELD.
next: Run exact-head proof; merge only if green. After merge, re-enter through FIELD and select at most one CURRENT-authorized consequence.
stop: Do not reintroduce a packet dashboard, second aggregation route, or synthetic NOW.
